name: EntraDeviceAuth
description: Authenticate Entra ID-enrolled devices using their device certificates and Azure Functions with this PowerShell module.
author: Florian Salzmann

securityCheck.aiSummary: The EntraDeviceAuth module implements a certificate-based device attestation workflow with Graph-backed validation. No obfuscated code, remote code execution, or hardcoded secrets detected. Data exchange includes certificate material (PublicKey, Certificate) as part of the attestation handshake, which should be protected in transit and at rest. Private keys are accessed for signing, which is standard but requires strict access controls and secure storage. Overall, design is appropriate for Intune/Entra device authentication, with explicit attention needed to key protections and TLS/configuration around data transmission.
